data.notes: As of this research pass, only the large-format UNTOLD Dubai festival has firm March 2027 music dates publicly confirmed; most club calendars and venue residencies have not yet published March 2027 programming.

events.title: UNTOLD Dubai 2027
events.summary: UNTOLD Dubai is confirmed for three days and nights at Dubai Parks and Resorts from 19–21 March 2027. The festival is positioned as Dubai's mega festival and is selling early-bird General Access and VIP passes.

events.title: The Dubai Experience 2027 Hosted by PBE Pluto
events.summary: A multi-day urban nightlife travel takeover hosted by Southern hip-hop artist PBE Pluto, built around exclusive day and nightlife events, Dubai club outings, and an optional yacht-party component.

events.title: ROCK THE BOAT Dubai – All White All-Inclusive Yacht Party 2027
events.summary: A late-night all-white yacht party tied to the Dubai urban travel-party circuit, running 11 PM–3 AM with an all-inclusive premium party format.
